title: Bohemia Interactive 收购 Everwind 开发商 Enjoy Studio 少数股权
content:
Bohemia Interactive takes minority stake in Everwind developer Enjoy Studio | GamesIndustry.biz

Read our editorial policy
.
Bohemia Interactive has secured an undisclosed minority stake in Polish developer Enjoy Studio, creator of co-op FPS survival RPG Everwind.
Bohemia Interactive is now a co-owner of the studio, marking its first investment in a Polish developer. Enjoy Studio will maintain its identity and creative independence.
Enjoy Studio joined Bohemia Interactive's Incubator program in 2024.
Established in 2016
, the program supports indie developers in creating and launching prototype games.
Enjoy Studio debuted with the open-world life simulation game
The Witch of Fern Island
, published by indie.io.
Everwind
entered early access on Steam in March 2026 and has sold more than 300,000 copies.
Last month, Bohemia Interactive published the 2.5D adventure platformer
Space Tail.
Enjoy Studio also provides publishing and porting services. For Aurorian Studios'
One Lonely Outpost
, it provided UI redesign and multi-platform production support.
"We have known Enjoy Studio closely for two years, and what convinced us most were the people behind it. We share a similar approach to making games and communicating with players," said Bohemia Interactive co-founder and CEO Marek Španěl (via
Game Developer
).
"Everwind has shown what this team is capable of, but this investment is not about a single game. It is an expression of our confidence in the talent of the entire studio and a step toward a closer, long-term partnership. We want to make the best games we can together and bring them to as many players as possible."
